params.evidence: 0.70% colchicine in the studied seed-powder batch. TNAU reports 0.5–0.7%, with genotype differences.
params.missing: Net pharmaceutical recovery; seed moisture/assay and selected cultivar

params.evidence: 6120 ±640 nmol/g dry leaf: jointly quantified digoxin + lanatoside C in industrial clones. Convert molar precursor pool to digoxin equivalent (1 mol to 1 mol); NOT 0.478% measured free digoxin.
params.missing: Extraction + precursor conversion + final manufacturing recovery; local cultivar

params.base_status: HCl to base; molecular weights verified
params.evidence: S01 cultivated population: rainy-season mean 0.683% w/w; dry-season mean 0.727%. Other populations differ. This is source-dried material, not moisture-free biomass.
params.missing: Net recovery and standardized moisture basis for crop yield

params.evidence: One studied hybrid mean 20.04 ±4.05 mg/g dry wt; another 17.82 ±3.52. Reference genotype-specific observation, not universal yield.
params.missing: Selected hybrid and net pharmaceutical recovery

params.base_status: ASSUMPTION: sulfate monohydrate; confirm French product basis
params.evidence: Wild-type control plants: 0.92 mg hyoscyamine/g DW leaves; NOT genetically modified high-yield lines. Ideal racemization preserves mass; no factor of two.
params.missing: Confirm salt hydration; net recovery including racemization; representative crop assay

params.evidence: USDA reports colony-dependent podophyllotoxin 0–4% dry leaf. No representative positive concentration selected; zero-bearing colonies cannot supply API.
params.missing: Cultivar-specific podophyllotoxin assay and net recovery; actual supplier route

params.evidence: SAM clone ~1.4% artemisinin on DW basis. Potential artemether equivalent uses 1:1 molar transformation; artemether is NOT present at this concentration in leaves.
params.missing: Recovery + semisynthesis yield; plant-derived supply share; lumefantrine is outside plant route

params.base_status: label already expresses free API equivalent
params.evidence: Plant precursors include catharanthine and vindoline; one primary study control catharanthine 1.30 mg/g DW. A single precursor concentration cannot be used as vinorelbine yield.
params.missing: Paired precursor assays, limiting-precursor material balance, and complete semisynthesis yield

params.evidence: Etoposide is semisynthetic from podophyllotoxin. Shares precursor inventory with D06BB04; do not double allocate that inventory.
params.missing: Podophyllotoxin assay, stoichiometric conversion and complete process yield

params.material: Pharmaceutical-grade seed husk, NOT whole seeds
params.base_status: botanical material; not a pure API
params.evidence: API mass here is the husk already contained in the medicine. Identity conversion to finished husk only; NOT a 100% seed-to-husk yield.
params.missing: Whole-seed-to-clean-husk fraction and processing recovery if cultivation yields are in whole seeds
